# Gratom Babz Security Services Ltd

> Licensed Private kenyan security company offering manned guarding,CCTV,K9 Services,mobile patrol and 24/7 Alarm response nationwide

Head office on Kiambu Rd (off Kugeria North), Kiambu, with branches in Kiambu, Kikuyu/Wangige, Nairobi, Limuru, Thika and Mombasa/Malindi. 24-hour control room: +254 729 337 005.
